name: web-dark-ai-writing-site-with-ascii-orange-glyph-art
title: Long black page with orange dotted ASCII glyph art, framed feature cards and greyscale testimonials
whatItIs: A very tall black page: centred headings, three wide framed cards with corner plus marks where an orange dotted icon (magnifier, bar chart, handshake) faces a text block, a testimonial grid with greyscale portraits fading into orange, an FAQ, a dotted hands-on-keyboard graphic and a footer with a giant orange dotted 'Pandawa'.
whatItMeans: Technical and warm; dotted orange art gives an engraved, data feel.
techniques: Render icons as orange dot-matrix art.
Frame cards with corner plus marks.
Fade greyscale portraits into an orange glow.
End with a huge dotted wordmark.

vocabulary.definition: Images built from a grid of dots.
A photo fading into a coloured glow.
